title: calibrachoa pubescens

It is known for its vibrant yellow and orange flowers, which are rich in medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
